item.title: Purple Heart Project gala honors fallen soldier, raises 80,000 dollars
item.description: The Purple Heart Project held its seventh annual gala Saturday at The Kendall, honoring Army Pfc. Isabella Gonzales and four local Purple Heart recipients, and the auction raised 80,000 dollars.

item.title: Dickens on Main returns November 27 and 28
item.description: Dickens on Main returns to downtown Boerne on Friday, November 27, and Saturday, November 28, with a Christmas market, live music, a snow slide, and the tree lighting Friday evening.

item.title: Boerne and Champion open the playoffs at home
item.description: Boerne High hosts Brackenridge on Thursday night and Champion hosts Eagle Pass Winn on Friday night, both at 7 p.m. at Boerne ISD Stadium, to open the football playoffs.

item.title: Three Boerne-area volleyball seasons end Friday
item.description: Geneva fell in the TAPPS 4A state semifinal, Champion lost a five-set third-round match, and Boerne High was swept in the third round, ending all three Boerne-area volleyball seasons Friday.

item.title: Veterans Day ceremony set for Wednesday at Veterans Plaza
item.description: Boerne's Veterans of Foreign Wars Post 688 and American Legion Post 313 will hold a joint Veterans Day observance Wednesday, November 11, at 11 a.m. at Veterans Plaza, 801 S. Main St.

item.title: TxDOT to update residents on Texas 46 West safety work
item.description: TxDOT officials will give an update on the Texas 46 West safety project at a public session Tuesday, November 10, at 6:30 p.m. at the Patrick Heath Public Library.

item.title: Geneva falls 54-23 to Dallas Christian in first round of playoffs
item.description: Geneva opened the postseason Saturday at Dallas Christian in Mesquite and fell 54-23 in the first round of the TAPPS playoffs, ending the season at 9-2.

item.title: Both Champion cross country teams finish top 10 at state
item.description: Both Boerne Champion cross country teams finished in the top 10 at the 5A state meet Saturday in Round Rock, with the girls sixth and the boys eighth.

item.title: Boerne completes perfect regular season with 32-27 win over Legacy Ranch
item.description: Boerne High beat Liberty Hill Legacy Ranch 32-27 on the final play Friday night to finish a perfect 10-0 regular season, while Champion closed out at 9-1 with a 49-7 win at Manor.

item.title: Boerne council to hold hearing on Johns Road annexation, vote on stormwater charge Tuesday
item.description: Boerne City Council meets Tuesday, November 10: a public hearing and first reading on annexing about 6.46 acres at 727A Johns Road and rezoning it for a planned unit development; a one-time reading of Unified Development Code amendments; second reading of the monthly stormwater drainage charge; and a water treatment plant carbon project contract.

item.title: Boerne PD kicks off Blue Santa toy drive
item.description: The Boerne Police Department has kicked off its annual Blue Santa toy drive, accepting new, unwrapped toys and gift cards for children in need through December 14, with family applications due December 15.

item.title: Boerne holds first NAMIWalks along the Old No. 9 Trail
item.description: Boerne held its first NAMIWalks on October 31, a one-mile walk from the Patrick Heath Public Library amphitheater down the Old No. 9 Trail, with police, sheriff's deputies, and mental health advocates pointing residents toward the NAMI Bexar Warm Line.

item.title: Boerne ISD superintendent named Superintendent of the Year
item.description: Boerne ISD Superintendent Kristin Craft will receive the Lone Star State School Counselor Association's Superintendent of the Year award on November 15 in Dallas, recognizing her work strengthening school counseling programs.

item.title: This Weekend in Boerne and Kendall County: November 6-8
item.description: Thirty events fill the November 6-8 weekend in Boerne and Kendall County, from the European Motor Showcase and Lone Star Mopar Fest to the Fall Boerne Handmade Market and a full slate of library programs.

item.title: One killed, one hurt in head-on crash on SH-46 near Boerne
item.description: A head-on crash on State Highway 46 near Boerne killed one driver and injured another Wednesday around noon, and DPS is investigating why the eastbound car crossed into oncoming traffic.

item.title: MPO brings road plan comment session to Boerne November 18
item.description: The Alamo Area Metropolitan Planning Organization brings its Mobility 2050 public comment session to the Patrick Heath Public Library at 5 p.m. November 18, seeking input on about 39.2 billion dollars in proposed regional transportation investments.

item.title: Geneva opens playoffs Saturday at Dallas Christian
item.description: Geneva School of Boerne, 9-1, opens the TAPPS playoffs Saturday at 2 p.m. against district champion Dallas Christian, 8-2, at Wheeler Field in Mesquite.

item.title: Boerne Champion and Boerne High sweep into third round
item.description: Boerne Champion swept Medina Valley and Boerne High swept Fox Tech in second-round volleyball Tuesday, sending both Boerne ISD teams into the third round.

item.title: Neal McCoy to headline Center benefit concert Saturday
item.description: Neal McCoy headlines The Center's Starry Night benefit concert Saturday, November 7, at Estancia at Thunder Valley, with proceeds supporting Meals on Wheels and other programs for older adults in Kendall County.

item.title: Kendall County election results (unofficial)
item.description: Unofficial Kendall County results, updated through the night
